rollModel.scope: Public CoE model draws integer modifier values uniformly, using randomNumber(min,max+1,true). Exact14 of12–14 has probability1/3. This is calculator-model evidence, not observed in-game frequencies.

enkindling.assumptions: All11 integer rolls equally likely under the inspected CoE model; rerolls replace the existing enchant. Stop at70. No Instilling finish.
